title: [Extensibility Request] issue 29654: customize document rejection response
summary: Workflow Setup now offers an overloaded method to define custom rejection responses for document approvals while maintaining backward compatibility with existing behavior.
key_points: Adds overload to InsertDocApprovalWorkflowSteps accepting rejection response code
Enables extensions to define custom rejection states
Preserves default open document behavior for current callers
quote: Added an overload for supplying the rejection response code while retaining the existing signature and default behavior.
